tasks.title: Sigma of the mean
tasks.statement: The noise of a single sample is σ = **{s}** °/s. What is the σ of the mean of **{n}** independent samples (°/s)?

tasks.title: Gain in fusion
tasks.statement: A prediction with variance P = **{p}** m², a measurement with R = **{r}** m². Find the fraction of the innovation added to the prediction (K).

tasks.title: Angle error from ARW
tasks.statement: A gyro with ARW = **{arw}** °/√h. What is the σ of the integrated angle error after **{t}** minutes (°)?
tasks.solution: σ_θ = ARW·√t, with time in hours: √(t/60).
